description: Relative field weights for priority scores: project overrides inherit portfolio overrides, which inherit global defaults. Scores use 40% saved ML evidence and 60% normalized field weights, preserving recorded rule floors. Runtime settings are JSON records in Tables/priority_field_weights/records.json; saved analysis is reweighted immediately and future projects inherit their portfolio's weights.
